## Frequently Asked Questions

### How is this different from prompt packs?

Prompt packs give you generic templates that work the same for everyone. They tell AI to "be professional" or "sound friendly."

MyWritingTwin is fundamentally different. We forensically extract YOUR writing patterns from YOUR actual writing samples. The result captures:

- -- Your actual vocabulary (not generic "professional" words)

- -- Your sentence rhythm (short punches vs. flowing paragraphs)

- -- Your transition patterns (how YOU connect ideas)

- -- Your formality shifts (how you write to your CEO vs. your team)

- -- Your cultural and linguistic nuances (keigo levels, tu/vous, etc.)

Prompt packs tell AI what to sound like. Style Profiles show AI how you actually write, with concrete examples. That's why AI trained on your Style Profile produces output you can use with minimal editing.

Not at all. If you can copy-paste and follow step-by-step instructions, you can build your Writing Twin. We provide detailed guides for every step of the process.
